From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

Italian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin ēligere. Piecewise doublet of scegliere.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /eˈlɛd.d͡ʒe.re/
  • Rhymes: -ɛddʒere
  • Hyphenation: e‧lèg‧ge‧re

Verb

[edit]

elèggere (first-person singular present elèggo, first-person singular past historic elèssi, past participle elètto, auxiliary avére)

  1. (transitive) to elect, nominate, appoint
    Synonym: nominare
  2. (transitive, formal) to fix
    Synonym: fissare
    eleggere il proprio domicilio a Milano ― to fix one's domicile in Milan
